name: Acapulco Gold
summary: Acapulco Gold is a [[kind:landrace|landrace]] traditionally grown in the mountains of Guerrero, [[country:MX|Mexico]], named for the brownish-gold color of its cured flowers. It was first recorded in the United States in 1964, and is one of the three parents of [[skunk-1|Skunk #1]]. Some sources place its origin in neighboring Oaxaca; others describe it as a cross with [[nepalese|Nepalese]] stock.
